Bring the signed-in FPO admin's page to the front. The first call of a run opens a headless Chromium and signs +919000000001 in through the login form (mobile, dev OTP, then the PIN step; a fresh seed has no PIN yet, so the form chooses 1234). Later calls reuse that page, so a run spends one admin OTP (the API allows 10 per phone per day). Tests call it before their API fixtures: the API sign-in (`Login As`) can wait out the one-code-per-60 s limit, the form cannot. Fails: a sign-in step is not reached within the Browser timeout, or an earlier test's sign-in failed (no retry: each attempt would spend another OTP). Side effects: sets the suite variable ${ADMIN_PAGE}; on a fresh seed sets the admin's PIN.

suite.doc: FPO admin portal acceptance (plan §7.3 P01-P08) and the P07 chain. Serves: FR-8, FR-9, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14, FR-15, FR-23, FR-25, FR-29, FR-37, FR-41, FR-46, FR-49, FR-58, FR-70; gate G4; WP Q07 (P01-P04 lines real). Run by: Q02 Verifier, gate G4. Needs `rfbrowser init` once and the portal served in live mode (`npm run dev`, no VITE_MSW) against the stack under test; see qa/robot/README.md. Every test drives the UI as the seeded FPO admin, signed in once per run through the login form. Data the line needs (farmers, plots, packed lots, QC grading) is made over the API with the agritrace_keywords fixtures; API reads only back up what the screen showed (the stored status, the audit row, the QR content). Ready lots is opened with a full page load, because the portal caches lots and hold flags for 30 s and each test makes its lots just before. Placeholders are tagged not-ready and skip until their WP merges.
